serialization.raw_text_definition: Exact UTF-8 encoding of connector-returned content strings, without newline or BOM normalization.
serialization.selected_object_definition: Complete selected JSON object from the corresponding successful listing response, serialized with JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) and a final newline; not claimed to retain original HTTP formatting.
serialization.root_retry_copy: ROOT_RERUN_REJECTION.json contains the root's supplied actual response, explicitly attributed.

original_job_log.retrieval_origin: Root agent's successful workflow-job-log connector call, then retained as a public Git blob. Publisher independently fetched that blob and checked the complete bytes.

codeql_aggregate_route: Only commit-scoped check-runs listings were fetched; individual check-run and annotation routes were not called.

retrieval_times.aggregate_objects: Read after the workflow snapshot through the two recorded commit-scoped listing routes.
